title: ocimum basilicum var. pilosum
intro: Ocimum basilicum var. pilosum, commonly known as Hairy Basil or Pilosum Basil, is a variant of sweet basil that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate digestive issues due to its anti-inflammatory and carminative properties. The therapeutic actions of Hairy Basil include its ability to act as an antioxidant, antimicrobial, and antiseptic, making it useful for wound healing and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of Ocimum basilicum var. pilosum include eugenol, linalool, and beta-caryophyllene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
